name: Create a Project for an Organization
description: Create a Project for an Organization Create a new project for an organization. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/projects/
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/projects/
Create a new project for an organization. A personal team (`team-{username}`) is automatically created for the caller with Team Admin role, and the project is bound to it. If the org has member project creation disabled (`disable_member_project_creation`), `org:write` scope is required.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: List an Organization's Projects
description: List an Organization's Projects Return a list of projects bound to a organization. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/projects/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/projects/
Return a list of projects bound to a organization.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.; per_page (query) — Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.; query (query) — Filter projects by name or slug.
